responsibility: Implements the on-disk cache used to reuse LTRANS input/output file pairs across link-time optimization runs. This file owns checksum-based cache lookup, byte-for-byte file identity checks, creation of uniquely named cached input and corresponding .ltrans output files, persistence of cache metadata in the cachedata file, lockfile-based coordination of concurrent creators and pruners, and least-recently-used style pruning when the cache exceeds its soft size limit. It consumes temporary LTRANS input files and produces managed cached file entries and metadata that later LTRANS invocations can query and reuse.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation behind the lto-ltrans-cache interface: it performs checksum and file-content comparison, cachedata serialization/deserialization, cache-file name allocation, lock-coordinated insertion and pruning, and actual filesystem operations on cached input/.ltrans files. Unlike gcc/lto-ltrans-cache.h, this file contains the executable cache-management logic rather than the API and data layout declarations.
